svg.aria-label: How a task moves: from your words through Focus, the plan check, the launch rule, Maker, the check and one card to your accept and your merge, every step on the ledger

text.tspan: Describe the task, in the app or the terminal
Checks the plan matches what you asked
Starts the build on its own if it's small and safe
Reticle writes tests of what you asked, which Maker
Maker builds it in a locked-down sandbox
Your tests and Reticle's run, Second Eye reviews
the change blind, Field tries the app
One card: ready to accept, or one question
Accept: Parallax saves exactly what was reviewed

svg.text: Every step is written to a tamper-evident log.
